name: System Dictionary Lookup
description: Use Apple's on-device Foundation Models to pick the sense that fits the paper you are reading: IPA plus two or three concise senses in Zotero's selection popup, ranked by the paper's title, abstract and your earlier lookups. 用 macOS 端侧 Foundation Models 按当前论文语境排序，只留最贴切的两三条释义。
author: Wang Mingpei
